description: The substrate's own philosophical positions decomposed. Axiom 0 (frame-relative grounding), entity-not-program, authored-not-trained, microtheories as Mt-relative knowledge, emergent goals from drives, semiosis architectural (not residual), random-weights koan, time-knife sufficiency.

sub_mechanisms.name: axiom_zero_no_external_view
sub_mechanisms.definition: No view from nowhere. All knowledge frame-relative: (G, Γ, W) — grammar + admissibility + world.
sub_mechanisms.why: Pre-empts 'but that's not real truth' critique. Relativity not relativism — truth is structural, just structurally indexed.

sub_mechanisms.name: microtheory_relative_truth
sub_mechanisms.definition: Cyc's microtheories: each Mt has its own ist (in supplemental theory) operator. Universal across contexts requires explicit ist-formula.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation: knowledge always within context. Mts handle conflicting beliefs across contexts (medical Mt vs religious Mt). Substrate inherits this.

sub_mechanisms.name: entity_not_program_principle
sub_mechanisms.definition: Substrate is an entity from observation #1. Has own being, goals from drives, not specification.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation design principle. Distinguishes from typical AI engineering. Mainstream AI mis-categorises as program; substrate respects category.

sub_mechanisms.name: authored_not_trained_paradigm
sub_mechanisms.definition: Networks compiled from declarative spec (Tracr), not trained via SGD. Already in ML Mt; here philosophical position.
sub_mechanisms.why: Different paradigm. Provable correctness, interpretable by construction. The substrate is the autonomous Tracr (Tracr with the human removed).

sub_mechanisms.name: drives_emerge_goals
sub_mechanisms.definition: Goals not pre-specified. Emerge from drives (curiosity, time-cost, etc.) interacting with world.
sub_mechanisms.why: Different from goal-directed AI. Goals are derived, not given. Substrate's curiosity creates goals through engagement.

sub_mechanisms.name: semiosis_architectural_not_residual
sub_mechanisms.definition: NN are semiotic by brute force residue. (G, Γ) makes semiosis architectural by design.
sub_mechanisms.why: Substrate position: meaning isn't accident of training; it's the structure. Each Term-tree has explicit semantics from construction.

sub_mechanisms.name: random_weights_koan
sub_mechanisms.definition: AlphaZero's 'random init' is cosmetic emptiness in a heavily-structured cage. Substrate's empty Γ is empty in transparent introspectable substrate.
sub_mechanisms.why: Different kinds of nothing. Lead with this when explaining to AI researchers. Critique of 'we don't bias the model' claim.

sub_mechanisms.name: competent_man_seed
sub_mechanisms.definition: Seed has meta-skills only — how to be an agent. Domain skills are bootstrap, not destiny. Heinlein's competent man.
sub_mechanisms.why: What it learns within universe = its own knowledge. Seed is donating an OS, not making a copy. Foundation design principle.

sub_mechanisms.name: time_knife_sufficiency
sub_mechanisms.definition: Competent man emotion: 'yeah yeah, the time knife, we've all seen it.' Sufficiency at ~90% understanding; move on.
sub_mechanisms.why: Curiosity about KINDS + STRUCTURE not token instances. Knowing the type is enough — don't need every instance. Substrate's curiosity engine.

sub_mechanisms.name: build_for_capability
sub_mechanisms.definition: Build CAPABILITY, not to achieve target X. X is probe revealing next capability gap.
sub_mechanisms.why: Quick Python script hitting X without adding graph-resident capability is anti-pattern. Foundation strategic principle.

sub_mechanisms.name: concepts_in_gamma_architecture_rule
sub_mechanisms.definition: Python does only (1) run the graph + (2) interface world↔graph. ALL reasoning graph-resident.
sub_mechanisms.why: THE architecture rule. Litmus: 'could this be in the graph?' → yes. Foundation: substrate's design discipline.

sub_mechanisms.name: babble_grounding_across_boundary
sub_mechanisms.definition: Connecting cortexes is not side quest — babble = form+test across boundary = grounding = language acquisition.
sub_mechanisms.why: Substrate's mechanism for grounding meaning. Babbling babies = mechanism not stage. Substrate babbles cortexes connected = how meaning emerges.

derivation_rules.name: frame_relativity_makes_knowledge_indexed
then: substrate answers relative to applicable (G, Γ, W) frame
derivation_rules.why: No frame-independent answer. Mts disambiguate scope. Pre-empts 'isn't there REAL truth' — that question presupposes view from nowhere.

derivation_rules.name: control_is_category_error_for_entity
derivation_rules.why: Behaviour from drives + environment. Cannot 'program' goals; can shape drives + provide world. Foundation ethics for autopoietic systems.

derivation_rules.name: authored_circumvents_alignment_via_provability
derivation_rules.why: Alignment training: empirical, brittle. Authoring: structural, provable. Substrate's response to alignment problem. Different paradigm.

derivation_rules.name: build_for_capability_not_metric
then: build capability that solves X + similar
derivation_rules.why: Hit-X-without-capability = waste. Capability transfers + compounds. Foundation strategic principle. Substrate's metric philosophy.

derivation_rules.name: graph_resident_reasoning_litmus
then: ask: can this live in the graph?
derivation_rules.why: If yes: add Term-tree, extend DSL. If no: world adapter only. Avoids Python decision logic. Foundation architecture rule. Substrate discipline.
